summary: Mrs. Hidary explores the themes of inner glory and splendor by connecting the construction of the Mishkan in Parashat Tessave to the story of Purim. She discusses how the Kohen Gadol's clothing and the concept of brotherhood serve as models for overcoming a defeatist mentality and embracing the power of the oral Torah.
questions: Why is the Kohen Gadol permitted to wear shatnez?
How does the story of Purim relate to the Mishkan?
What does it mean to combat a defeatist mentality?
Why is the second Beit HaMikdash associated with the oral Torah?
